hero.desc: A high-performance, decoupled frontend architecture engineered with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and daisyUI. Designed for optimal load speeds, structural localization stability, and visual premium interfaces.
card.island.title: Island Architecture
card.island.desc: Zero client-side JavaScript by default, hydrating interactive blocks only when needed for peak performance.
card.i18n.title: Multilingual Routing
card.i18n.desc: Integrated localization engines mapped to locale subdirectory routes for seamless user access.
card.responsive.title: Responsive Specs
card.responsive.desc: Structured breakpoints ensuring clean interface delivery on mobile devices, tablets, and wide monitors.
about.title: About Swecha
about.subtitle: Driven by free software values, we build technologies to empower communities.
about.mission.title: Mission
about.mission.detail: Bridging the digital divide by providing localized GNU/Linux solutions and global software tools to local users.
about.origins.title: Origins
about.origins.detail: Founded to support the Swecha project, we are a vibrant collective of developers, students, and academicians dedicated to the free software model.
about.technical.title: Technical
about.technical.detail: Overcoming technical barriers by developing GPL-licensed Telugu fonts and collaborating globally with the FontForge community.
about.impact.title: Impact
about.impact.detail: By standardizing technical terminology through community feedback and collaborative translation, we successfully launched the localized GNU/Linux version in 2005.
